_about: Work people around Whiterun need done. Same fields as riverwood_work.json. A giver who is not in a social seed file is written as Plugin.esm:0xBASEID (their base form id, as the Living World log prints it for 'new NPC'). need.item may list several items separated by | ; any of them counts.

templates.title: help bring in the harvest at Battle-Born Farm
templates.why: The leeks, wheat and gourds have to come in before the weather turns, and the farmhands cannot pick it all alone
templates.instructions: Pick leeks, wheat and gourds in the Battle-Born Farm fields outside Whiterun and bring the crops to her; she pays for what is brought in.

templates.title: help bring in the harvest at Pelagia Farm
templates.why: The farm feeds a good part of Whiterun's market, and there are more crops ripe than hands to pick them
templates.instructions: Pick the crops in the Pelagia Farm fields just outside Whiterun's gate and bring them to him; he pays for what is brought in.
